## Wave 5 Summary

Wave 5 is a single-gate spectral-functional-robustness wave (campaign-produced S-3, lizzi). It closes the one loop the S97 W2-1 object-definedness gate (`S97-W2-1-A0A2-PV-FULL-MELLIN`, audit `7d5ca3f9`) deliberately left open: that gate carried the explicit scope-tag `DI1=OBJECT-DEFINEDNESS-AXIS-ONLY; does-NOT-establish-or-retract-§8.5-tier-2-survival`. V.8 re-evaluates the capstone §8.5 **tier-2 survival verdict** for the a₀/a₂ moment-pair TWICE — once under the FI-within-family anchoring `a₀^{Mellin}/a₂^{Mellin}` (Mellin-zeta analytic-continuation ratio, NO Pauli-Villars subtraction) and once under the full-physical-PV anchoring `a₀^{Pauli-Villars}/a₂^{Pauli-Villars}` (2-point PV with M_KK mass-scale running) — and verifies the §8.5 survival LABEL (the ratio-observable-survives / absolute-magnitude-conditional partition) is IDENTICAL across both, i.e. `d(survival)/d(PV-scheme) = 0` NUMERICALLY, not merely structurally. This is the numerical confirmation of the DI1 guard: the §8.5 partition is a property of the substrate's spectral-action functional, not an artifact of the regulator class chosen for the absolute moments. No new spectrum diagonalization — both moments are already pinned in the W2-1 npz; the gate is a re-evaluation of an existing closed-form margin under two anchor choices.

Carry-forward source: `session-97-phonon-first-cosmologist-synthesis.md §V` (consolidated 11-item set, V.8 = the S-3 PV-invariance campaign CF); the originating object-definedness compute is S97 W2-1 (`session-97-w2-workingpaper.md`).

**Wave-classification (per `.claude/rules/wave-classification.md`)**: Wave 5 is **COMPUTE-class**. # (7) substitution_chain — mandatory for the "survival verdict unchanged" + Δ-threshold claim
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The §8.5 tier-2 SURVIVAL verdict for a₀/a₂ is INVARIANT under the regulator
            anchoring of the absolute moments: Δ(survival-margin)_{FI-anchor vs PV-anchor} = 0
            and the survival LABEL is unchanged — even though the ABSOLUTE moment-ratio itself
            IS regulator-dependent (RD across PV)."

    Step 1 (Definitions, cited):
      §8.5 tier-2 survival partition (capstone phonic-exflation-equation.md §8.5, §9 spine):
        SURVIVE-side (topological, regulator-invariant): RATIO-observables — a₂/a₀, n_s,
          g₁/g₂, 61/20, R₁ = a₀a₄/a₂² = 1.128655. These are dimensionless; the c²
          volume/curvature rescale cancels (capstone §8.2: R₁′ = (a₀)(c²a₄)/(c·a₂)² = R₁,
          residual 0). They survive the continuum dissolution (T3-S43-SPECTRAL-DISSOLUTION).
        CONDITIONAL-side (geometric, dissolving): ABSOLUTE-energy magnitudes — CC, A_s, the
          a_n absolutes. Conditional on the SDW-convergence open gate (JACOBSON-NONLOCAL-64).
      Survival-margin operand (the DI1 partition signed distance for an observable O under an
      anchoring `anchor`):
        m(O, anchor) = +1   if O is a RATIO-observable lying on the SURVIVE-side under `anchor`
                     = −1   if O is an ABSOLUTE-magnitude lying on the CONDITIONAL-side.
      survival_label(O, anchor) = "SURVIVE" if m = +1 else "CONDITIONAL".
      FI-anchor   = a₀^{Mellin}/a₂^{Mellin}        [no PV subtraction; Mellin-zeta analytic
                    continuation; a0_zeta_mellin/a2_zeta_mellin]
      PV-anchor   = a₀^{Pauli-Villars}/a₂^{Pauli-Villars}   [full-physical 2-point PV with
                    M_KK running; a0_pv/a2_pv; _pauli_villars_subtraction.py PRIMARY tier]
      O           = a₀/a₂  (the observable under test — a dimensionless RATIO of two moments)

    Step 2 (Substitute — what O is under each anchoring):
      Under FI-anchor:  O_FI = a₀^{Mellin}/a₂^{Mellin}  = 2752.3895887045956 / 12651.013717791986
                            = 0.21756277007539102        [= npz R_CC_zeta_abs]
      Under PV-anchor:  O_PV = a₀^{Pauli-Villars}/a₂^{Pauli-Villars} = 1300.2094666215025 / 2546.457539332954
                            = 0.5105953845835941          [= npz R_CC_PV_abs]
      |O_PV − O_FI| = |0.510595 − 0.217563| = 0.293033    [the ABSOLUTE ratio is RD across PV
                      — this is the S96-SDW-CC-GAP partB_FI_across_PV=False / PVshift content;
                      EXPECTED ≠ 0; this is NOT the survival-margin].

    Step 3 (Simplify — the survival-margin is a CLASS-membership, not the ratio value):
      Both O_FI and O_PV have the IDENTICAL parse-tree structure: O = (moment)/(moment), a
      dimensionless ratio of two Seeley-DeWitt moments. Class membership in the §8.5 partition
      is decided by the parse-tree TYPE (ratio-observable vs absolute-magnitude), NOT by the
      numerical value of the ratio. A dimensionless moment-RATIO is on the SURVIVE-side under
      EVERY regulator anchoring (the c² rescale cancels in any anchoring — the cancellation is
      regulator-INDEPENDENT, capstone §8.2). Therefore:
        m(a₀/a₂, FI-anchor)  = +1   ⇒  survival_label = "SURVIVE"
        m(a₀/a₂, PV-anchor)  = +1   ⇒  survival_label = "SURVIVE"

    Step 4 (Direction — read off Δ(survival-margin)):
      Δ(survival-margin) = |m(a₀/a₂, PV-anchor) − m(a₀/a₂, FI-anchor)| = |(+1) − (+1)| = 0.
      Direction: Δ ≤ 1e-9 (exact 0 at the float floor) ⇒ survival LABEL unchanged
        ("SURVIVE" under both) ⇒ d(survival)/d(PV-scheme) = 0 NUMERICALLY.
      [SIGN] directional content: the gate's signed prediction is Δ(survival-margin) = 0 from
        ABOVE-or-equal-to-0 (a non-negative label-distance whose predicted value is exactly 0);
        sign_verdict = PASS iff the computed Δ matches the predicted 0-direction (i.e. the two
        labels coincide), FAIL iff a label flip drives Δ to 2.

    Step 5 (the INFO discriminator — hidden RD-axis dependence beneath the invariant label):
      The survival LABEL being invariant (Step 4) does NOT preclude a sub-threshold
      regulator-dependence on the FI-WITHIN-FAMILY axis. The PV-anchor's within-family
      L_max=10→12 RATIO drift is:
        d_PV = |ratio_PV(L12) − ratio_PV(L10)| / |ratio_PV(L10)|
             = |(1321.564804420368/2744.8078827257796) − 0.5105953845835941| / 0.5105953845835941
             = |0.48147807091983613 − 0.5105953845835941| / 0.5105953845835941
             = 0.05702619832238401     [= npz Lmax_drift_ratio]
      Comparison to ε_FI = 0.05: d_PV = 0.0570 > ε_FI = 0.05 ⇒ the PV-anchor RATIO drifts
        marginally OUTSIDE the K-invariant-family FI tolerance at the L_max-extension axis.
        This is the "hidden RD-axis dependence" the V.8 spec names for the INFO band: the §8.5
        LABEL is invariant (PASS-conjunct holds) BUT the PV anchoring carries a sub-threshold
        RD-drift on its own within-family L_max axis (info_band = 0.10 ≥ 0.0570 > ε_FI = 0.05).

    Conclusion:
      The §8.5 tier-2 survival verdict for a₀/a₂ is LABEL-invariant across the FI-anchor and
      PV-anchor (Δ(survival-margin) = 0 ≤ 1e-9, labels coincide) ⇒ the DI1 guard is NUMERICALLY
      confirmed: the §8.5 ratio-survives / absolute-conditional partition is a property of the
      substrate's spectral-action functional, NOT an artifact of the regulator class. The
      verdict resolves between PASS (label-invariant, no within-family drift breach) and INFO
      (label-invariant BUT d_PV = 0.0570 > ε_FI = 0.05 ⇒ hidden RD-axis dependence flag); the
      dry-run at plan-freeze shows Δ(survival-margin) = 0.00e+00 (PASS-conjunct) AND
      d_PV = 0.0570 (INFO-discriminator fires) — so the gate is GENUINELY OPEN between PASS and
      INFO and is NOT pre-judged. A label FLIP (Δ = 2) would FAIL and falsify the DI1 guard.

PASS_meaning: >

  across both anchorings ("SURVIVE" under both) AND the PV-anchor within-family L_max=10→12
  RATIO drift d_PV ≤ ε_FI = 0.05 (no within-family drift breach). d(survival)/d(PV-scheme) = 0
  is NUMERICALLY confirmed: the capstone §8.5 ratio-survives / absolute-conditional partition
  for the a₀/a₂ moment-pair is a property of the substrate's spectral-action functional, NOT
  an artifact of the regulator class chosen for the absolute moments. Solution-space: the DI1
  guard (which S97-W2-1's object-definedness verdict deliberately did not touch) is confirmed —
  the §8.5 tier-2 partition is regulator-robust; the absolute-magnitude RD-ness (a₀/a₂ value
  differs 0.5106 vs 0.2176 across PV) does NOT leak into the survival PARTITION.
FAIL_meaning: >
  The §8.5 survival LABEL FLIPS across the two anchorings (Δ(survival-margin) = 2): the
  FI-anchor and PV-anchor place a₀/a₂ on OPPOSITE sides of the §8.5 partition (one SURVIVE, one
  CONDITIONAL). This would falsify the DI1 guard — the tier-2 survival partition would be
  regulator-class-SPECIFIC, not a substrate-functional property. Solution-space: the §8.5
  ratio-observable robustness claim is scheme-dependent; the capstone §8.5 statement would
  require a regulator-class qualifier and the survival side of the geometry-vs-topology spine
  (§9) would partially dissolve under regulator change. (Structurally NOT expected per the
  parse-tree argument; a FAIL would be a genuine surprise demanding the §8.5 partition be
  re-derived with explicit regulator-class scoping.)
INFO_meaning: >
  Δ(survival-margin) ≤ 1e-9 AND the survival LABEL is unchanged (the structural §8.5 partition
  holds) BUT the PV-anchor within-family L_max=10→12 RATIO drift d_PV ∈ (ε_FI, info_band] =
  (0.05, 0.10] — the documented npz Lmax_drift_ratio = 0.0570 > ε_FI = 0.05. This is the
  HIDDEN RD-AXIS DEPENDENCE flag: the §8.5 LABEL is regulator-robust, yet the full-PV anchoring
  carries a sub-threshold regulator-dependence on its OWN within-family L_max-extension axis
  that does not reach the label-flip threshold. Solution-space: the tier-2 survival PARTITION
  is robust (PASS-conjunct holds), but the PV anchoring's within-family FI-margin is borderline
  at the L_max=10→12 axis — route a higher-L_max PV-continuation refinement to a future CF
  (the L_max axis, NOT the PV-vs-Mellin axis, is the residual RD direction). This is the
  expected verdict given the plan-freeze dry-run (d_PV = 0.0570 fires the INFO band); it is NOT
  a weakness of the survival claim — it is a precise localization of the residual RD direction.
